assessments.reasoning: The document is served by the official WG14 document archive and each page identifies N3220 as a working draft. The editorial cover identifies the post-C23 C2y context. Fresh capture digest bccd974cd9d0227c282c9557e12e29c90df115b403ea4269f58d69661acfc113 binds the full inspected response. The controlling passage is N3220 §6.2.5, Types, paragraph 11, printed page 39 / PDF page 52. WG14 working draft N3220 describes arithmetic performed in an unsigned type of width N as arithmetic modulo two to the power N. The operation is arithmetic performed in the unsigned type. An expression's effective arithmetic type depends on its applicable conversions. The rule describes the named working draft and does not assert modulo arithmetic for signed calculations or imply behavior for a particular compiler. The paragraph identifies the representable unsigned value range in terms of width. It distinguishes this calculation from the signed type and its range.
